environment.environment_policy: allowlist; isolated temporary HOME/cwd/XDG/TMPDIR; no real configs or clipboard

method.latency: x write start -> ACK plus following ESC[?2026l; not physical display
method.schedule: keys evenly spaced at interval midpoints; serial ACK waits; fail on window overrun
method.cpu: libproc tpane PID total user+system Mach ticks, all threads; 100%=one core; excludes driver/backends
method.memory_threads: raw CPU snapshots include RSS/virtual bytes/thread count at boundaries, not peaks
method.throughput: sum successful producer payload write bytes / parent start-to-stop-signal seconds; INCLUDES PTY/application buffers, not processed/rendered throughput
method.producer_windows: raw per-child signal handling timestamps/windows; signal delivery skew included; backend process CPU optional corroboration
method.clock: perf_counter_ns origins are process-local on older macOS Python; compare durations, NEVER parent/child absolute timestamps
method.drain: sequential root-tab selection after stop; DONE completed frame proves prior accepted bytes processed; stop-to-DONE includes selection and earlier panes' checks
method.hidden_check: scan host wire for BUSY/DONE markers while responder selected; not a full VT screen emulator
method.payload: 64-byte ASCII lines including CRLF; <=16KiB pending per producer; unsent bytes discarded at stop
method.limitations: Python production/driver scheduling/PTY transport affect results; no control over external load, thermals, power, or build flags
